description.value: Whether on film or the battlefield, the extra push of your hardlight magic is all you need to perform death defying stunts. When you @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.actions.Item.o8lqmFexiwcaLpu3]{Set the Spotlight} on yourself, you can @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.actions.Item.ttL2TstfSqOyzCd2]{Cast a Role} to apply the action role to yourself as a free action. As long as you are in a spotlight with the action role, you can use Performance in place of Athletics to [[/act high-jump skill="performance"]] and [[/act long-jump skill="performance"]] and in place of Acrobatics to [[/act grab-an-edge skill="performance"]].
